verdict.rationale: Tailscale's docs and user testimonials describe true peer-to-peer mesh connections (SSH into servers, K8s, NAS) bypassing traditional VPN/proxy setups, and many users confirm this 'just works' for direct access. However, community evidence shows NAT traversal often fails, silently falling back to Tailscale's DERP relay servers, which reduces speeds — contradicting the pure 'no relay' claim.
